# Background & key references {.unnumbered}

*This chapter points to the authoritative sources for SCHISM and AED.*

## SCHISM

SCHISM (Semi-implicit Cross-scale Hydroscience Integrated System Model) is an
unstructured-grid, semi-implicit 3D model for cross-scale ocean, coastal and
estuarine application [@zhang2016schism].

- Project site & user manual: <https://ccrm.vims.edu/schismweb/>
- Source & documentation: <https://github.com/schism-dev/schism>

## AED

AED (Aquatic EcoDynamics) is the biogeochemistry library coupled to SCHISM here;
it shares its modelling lineage with the GLM-AED framework [@hipsey2019glmaed].

- AED science manual: <https://aquaticecodynamics.github.io/aed-science/>
- Build tooling: <https://github.com/AquaticEcoDynamics/AED_Tools>
